payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about the baseline systems used in the study, including the types of data and methods employed.

claims.text: The baseline systems were built using KyTea-segmented Japanese texts and pyvi-segmented Vietnamese texts.
Two baseline systems were created: one using traditional phrase-based statistical machine translation (SMT) and the other using neural machine translation (NMT).
The training set for the baseline systems was small, but NMT systems outperformed phrase-based SMT models in translation effectiveness.
